lines.text: After finishing His teaching, Jesus went to Capernaum, where a centurion's highly valued servant was sick and about to die.
The centurion sent Jewish elders to ask Jesus to heal his servant, and they said he built their temple.
Near the house, the centurion sent friends to say he was unworthy and Jesus should just say the word.
Jesus marveled at the centurion and told the crowd He had not found such great faith even in Samaria.
When the messengers returned to the house, they found the servant in good health.
